commits.author: Ubuntu
commits.subject: fix(agent): detect user shell from /etc/passwd when SHELL env is unset
commits.body:
When the agent runs as a service (e.g., via systemd), the SHELL environment
variable is not set. This caused tmux sessions to default to bash instead of
the user's configured shell (e.g., zsh).

Now detectUserShell() falls back to reading from /etc/passwd via getent
when SHELL is not set.
